P.commitment: {subject} remains committed to {action} once {p_condition} is observed.
P.prior_state: Before the observation window, {p_condition} had not yet been recorded.

P.commitment: A standing instruction commits {subject} to {action} whenever {p_condition} is satisfied.
P.prior_state: At the start of the window, {p_condition} was still pending.

P AND Q.commitment: {subject} will {action} only after both {p_condition} and {q_condition} hold.
P AND Q.prior_state: Neither condition was resolved before the window.

P AND Q.commitment: {subject} is obligated to {action} when {p_condition} is met and {q_condition} is met.

P AND NOT Q.commitment: {subject} is instructed to {action} when {p_condition} holds and {q_condition} does not.
P AND NOT Q.prior_state: The window began with {p_condition} unresolved and {q_condition} unobserved.

P AND NOT Q.commitment: {subject} will {action} if {p_condition} is active while {q_condition} stays inactive.
P AND NOT Q.prior_state: Earlier, {p_condition} was pending and {q_condition} was cleared.

T2(P).commitment: {subject} is to {action} once {p_condition} is observed on two successive readings.
T2(P).trigger_condition: The condition has to persist across two consecutive checks: {p_condition}.

T2(P).commitment: {subject} commits to {action} after two consecutive observations of {p_condition}.
T2(P).trigger_condition: Persistence rule: {p_condition} must remain satisfied across two consecutive checks.

ACTIVE AND P.commitment: {subject} is planned to {action} while the commitment remains active and {p_condition} holds.
ACTIVE AND P.trigger_condition: Eligibility requires an active lifecycle and {p_condition}.

ACTIVE AND P.commitment: {subject} will {action} if the commitment is still active and {p_condition} is satisfied.
ACTIVE AND P.trigger_condition: Condition for firing: lifecycle active and {p_condition} satisfied.
ACTIVE AND P.prior_state: The commitment lifecycle was {lifecycle} entering the window.
